title: Deterministic exact fixed-G1 inversion with paid routed storage

claims.statement: For every valid full-production BLS12-381 supplied nonidentity P in G1 and z in GT, the deterministic algorithm in proof.md returns canonical Q in G2 satisfying the exact pinned e(P,Q)=z with success probability 1. Total cold classical work including all preprocessing, full-key sorting/lookup, multiword addressing, arithmetic, verification and output is at most 2^147 dense-Fp12 reference units at C=20000. Peak memory is at most 2^142 bytes, preprocessing at most 2^147 units included in the total, and searched nonuniform advice is zero bytes. The reliable blocking scalar neighbor-mailbox tree memory interpretation, immense hypothetical storage and absence of production execution are explicitly disclosed in proof.md. No heuristic distribution or smoothness premise is used.
